title: Grok keeps sending gibberish responses to users | TechCrunch
summary: An unusual glitch has resulted in xAI’s Grok chatbot speaking gibberish to many users. Responding to unhappy users, the Grok account confirmed the issues on X: “That pure word salad is a rare temporary generation glitch.
